kalshi.ui_observation: The Pro Baseball Champion event page displayed an event-level dollar volume, including when a single outcome market was selected; it did not display a separate USD trading-volume figure for that individual market. The API volume_fp field is contract quantity, not observed dollar turnover.

interpretation: These upper bounds are not ranked USD trading volumes.
